en: Records from different sources that describe one place are merged into one. Each place gets a data reliability from 0 to 100 (source type, a second source, freshness). A country page needs at least 100 public places with reliability 50 or more, a city page at least 20. The formula and the thresholds are explained here:
nb_checked: Oppføringer fra ulike kilder som beskriver samme sted, slås sammen til én. Hvert sted får en datapålitelighet fra 0 til 100 (kildetype, en ekstra kilde, ferskhet). En landside krever minst 100 offentlige steder med pålitelighet 50 eller mer, en byside minst 20. Formelen og tersklene forklares her:
back_en: Entries from different sources that describe the same location are merged into one. Each location gets a data reliability from 0 to 100 (source type, an extra source, freshness). A country page requires at least 100 public locations with reliability 50 or more, a city page at least 20. The formula and the thresholds are explained here:
remark: '(kildetype, en ekstra kilde, ferskhet)' is a telegraphic list; 'en ekstra kilde' reads oddly as a factor name. 'får en datapålitelighet' slightly awkward (better 'en pålitelighetsscore').

back_en: Consumption from the battery in mild weather, an estimate (Open EV Data, © 2019 Chargeprice, MIT); in winter about 20–30 % more. Losses during charging are not included. Public prices: the country index; where it is missing — «—».

Placeholder {country_u} must carry its own preposition (e.g. 'i Norge'); otherwise ungrammatical.
Bare 'Fellesskap' as a source label is slightly unnatural; 'Fellesskapsdata' would be clearer.

en: Prices: the ad hoc tariff of each network — what anyone pays without a contract or a subscription — from the operator's own price page or, where the operator publishes none, from a dated news report quoting it. Prices with VAT, per kWh. Prices per minute or per session, prices older than 12 months and prices whose source is unclear are shown on the country pages but stay out of the index.
nb_checked: Priser: ad hoc-tariffen til hvert ladenettverk — det alle betaler uten avtale eller abonnement — fra operatørens egen prisside eller, der operatøren ikke publiserer noen, fra en datert nyhetsartikkel som siterer den. Priser inkl. mva., per kWh. Priser per minutt eller per økt, priser eldre enn 12 måneder og priser med uklar kilde vises på landsidene, men holdes utenfor indeksen.
back_en: Prices: the ad hoc tariff of each charging network — what everyone pays without an agreement or subscription — from the operator's own price page or, where the operator does not publish one, from a dated news article that cites it. Prices incl. VAT, per kWh. Per-minute or per-session prices, prices older than 12 months and prices with an unclear source are shown on the country pages but kept out of the index.
remark: Minor ambiguity: 'som siterer den' — 'den' could refer to the tariff or the price page (intended: tariff).
